policy.acceptance: every unchanged source-arm nm endpoint must reproduce; all native callbacks and adverse geometry retained
policy.construction: lexicographic heavy neighbors u,v define bisector b and normal n; H directions a*b +/-sqrt(1-a^2)*n with a=-1/(3*cos(theta/2)); lexicographic first H takes +normal, original C-H radius retained
policy.enrollment: all three original 1TIM source arms and existing seeds1/2, three matched CH2 arms each; no new seeds/retries/geometry cleanup
policy.geometry: both H-heavy cosines -1/3; fixed heavy-heavy angle retained and H-H angle implied; refuse zero/collinear/infeasible frames, no arbitrary fallback or label/energy search
policy.invariants: only local LEU48 HB2/HB3 or all generated carbon-CH2 H initially move; ASP49 HA/all heavy/other H exact; all original masses/forces unchanged
policy.limits: H-stage mechanism only, not new proteins or whole-system/production qualification; no force ablation, integration or extra relaxation
policy.ownership: carbon with exactly2 newly mobile H and2 heavy neighbors in canonical same-residue context; measured/kept H never rewritten
policy.timing: prospective control after saved-only LEU48 HB2 attribution; freeze before any CH2 arm evaluation
